items.quote: was Queen of Great Britain and Ireland as the wife of King George III
items.note: Answer is correct (en:Charlotte,_North_Carolina: named in honor of Charlotte of Mecklenburg-Strelitz), but the question gives it away: the city's own name is the answer. Suggested rewording: "Charlotte, 'The Queen City', is named after the wife of which British king?" Answer: George III.

items.quote: It is the county seat of Mecklenburg County.
Charlotte is home to the Carolina Panthers of the National Football League (NFL)
the Charlotte Hornets of the National Basketball Association (NBA)
items.note: The team was the Charlotte Bobcats from 2004 to 2014; the current name is Hornets, so the answer is current.

items.quote: it officially opened on May 11, 2010, with the inaugural class inducted the day following the 2010 NASCAR Sprint All-Star Race
items.note: Fact is right (opened 11 May 2010, in Uptown Charlotte), but NASCAR is a sanctioning body, not a motorsport; a room answering 'stock car racing' has a fair case. Suggested rewording: "Which racing organisation opened its Hall of Fame in Uptown Charlotte in 2010?"

items.quote: Charlotte's central business district is referred to as "Uptown" by locals
items.note: The same article notes 'Downtown' and 'Center City' are also used; the word 'usually' in the question keeps Uptown the single answer, but a host may want to accept Center City.

items.quote: Bank of America, the second-largest financial institution by total assets in the United States, is headquartered in Charlotte
items.note: Truist Financial is also headquartered in Charlotte (en:Truist: 'an American bank holding company headquartered in Charlotte', the tenth-largest US bank), so 'Truist' is a correct answer as worded. Suggested rewording: "Which bank, the second-largest in the US by assets, has its headquarters in Charlotte and its name on the Panthers' stadium?"

items.quote: It is located in the North Charlotte neighborhood centered around North Davidson Street and 36th Street
items.note: The article gives the name as a portmanteau of 'North Davidson arts', i.e. still from the street.

items.quote: MLS awarded its expansion team to Charlotte in 2019, which began play as Charlotte FC in 2022
